title: Hydra — .hydra/secrets.yaml
description: How the secrets of the project are shown and where they come from. The values themselves are never here: they are in .hydra/secrets and .hydra/secrets.<env> (one NAME=value per line, ignored by git), in environment variables, or in a SOPS-encrypted file. Use a secret as ${SECRET:NAME}.

visibility.description: How secret values appear in logs, errors, action outputs and undo. Overridden by --secrets-visibility or HYDRA_SECRETS_VISIBILITY.
enumDescriptions: Replaced by [MASKED], and lines that would reveal a secret are left out

provider.description: Additional source of secrets, read after the environment variables and the .hydra/secrets files. Planned, not available yet: vault, azure-keyvault, aws-secrets-manager.

sops.description: Settings of the SOPS provider. Needs the sops and age programs on the PATH.

file.description: Encrypted file, relative to the project root. {env} is replaced by the active environment.

format.description: Format of the encrypted file. Default: from the extension (.yaml/.yml, .json, otherwise dotenv).

age_key_file.description: age private key. Default: SOPS_AGE_KEY_FILE, then the sops default location.
